name: Geralf Cecani
description: Geralf Cecani is an Innistrad stitcher and necromancer who builds skaab armies and is the bitter-rival brother of Gisa.

summary.text: Geralf Cecani is an Innistrad stitcher and necromancer who builds skaab armies and is the bitter-rival brother of Gisa.

bio.text: Geralf wrote to Ludevic of Ulm seeking mentorship in necromantic fabrication, and Ludevic offered to take him under his wing.

citations.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.
"Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

bio.text: He scolded Gisa for raising their parents and told her not to contact him, yet secretly sent skaabs to free her from the prison caravan.

citations.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.
"Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

bio.text: He repeatedly refused to come to Gisa's aid when she was bored and begged her to go anywhere else.

citations.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.
"The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion he defended Havengul from his hidden laboratory, joined Gisa against the Phyrexians, and stitched a behemoth and sea-beast together.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

bio.text: On Thunder Junction he joined Oko's crew as a necromancer and medic, and he and Gisa retrieved the map to Tarnation from Thief's Folly.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

bio.text: Oko disbanded the crew after announcing that Vraska and Ashiok had betrayed them.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

status.text: In the latest story Geralf is alive, and his crew was disbanded by Oko with a promise of a future reunion.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Siblings Gisa and Geralf, banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal, moved to the Moorland and war against each other with undead armies.
timeline.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and have since moved to the Moorland

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Geralf overran the village of Trostad with his undead while Gisa besieges it, and he raids Nearheath villages.
timeline.quote: which has been entirely overrun by Geralf and his undead creations.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Amsel and Reika are besieged by undead on the moors and shelter with necromancer Geralf Cecani.
timeline.quote: They found temporary refuge with a young man named Geralf Cecani

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins are banished from Thraben and wage undead war against each other in the Moorland.
timeline.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and then moved to the Moorland

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes over Trostad and Gisa attacks it, starting NecroWarfare.
timeline.quote: Geralf took over Trostad, most likely massacring the inhabitants who didn't flee.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sets up the siege of Thraben, sneaks in to kill Mikaeus, and meets Liliana who brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, then busies himself with his masterpiece under Ludevic.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cecani twins are banished from Thraben in a scandal and move to the Moorland, where they wage war with undead armies.
timeline.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and moved to the Moorland

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes over Trostad and Gisa attacks it just to best her brother, starting NecroWarfare.
timeline.quote: Gisa attacked Trostad simply to best her brother, starting what they called "NecroWarfare".

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf tries to set formal rules for the war, which Gisa ignores.
timeline.quote: Geralf had tried to set formal rules, named The Five Laws of NecroWarfare :

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf starts the siege of Thraben and invites Gisa along, ending their engagement; he sneaks into the city to kill Mikaeus.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Later he met up with Liliana , who shortly thereafter brought Mikaeus back as a zombie .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, who says she did not need his help; she retreats to her parents' manor and revives them as zombies.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf kills Mikaeus the Lunarch during the Siege of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Geralf killed Mikaeus the Lunarch

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben; Mikaeus appoints Thalia supreme commander after Luthor is found dead.
timeline.quote: he appointed Thalia as the supreme commander of the city's forces

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sneaks behind the defenses and stabs Mikaeus with a letter opener, carving out his heart.
timeline.quote: Geralf assaulted him with a letter opener, fatally stabbing the Lunarch

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Avacyn's absence, Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben; Geralf kills Lunarch Mikaeus and Liliana raises him as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Lunarch Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben with ghouls and skaabs.
timeline.quote: They besieged the city of Thraben with their ghoulish army

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus is killed in the assault and entombed in secret beneath the cathedral.
timeline.quote: So Mikaeus was entombed in secret, whisked away to the clandestine catacombs beneath the cathedral.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa briefly set aside their differences to join Liliana against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to join her and team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf briefly team up against the Eldrazi that invaded Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
timeline.quote: I am in need of a mentor

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she has broken out of prison.
timeline.quote: GUESS WHO JUST BROKE OUT OF PRISON!

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf scolds Gisa for raising their parents and tells her not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: You are being incredibly irresponsible.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Ludevic offers to take Geralf under his wing, sending alchemical texts.
timeline.quote: If you are amenable, I am more than happy to take you under my proverbial wing.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf thanks Ludevic but declares he is sick of games.
timeline.quote: I am absolutely sick of games.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
timeline.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
timeline.quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
timeline.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: Do not contact me again.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
timeline.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
timeline.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
timeline.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa by letter he wants nothing to do with her, then is horrified when she declares she will move in with him.
timeline.quote: Geralf wrote to his sister that he wanted nothing to do with her

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
timeline.quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
timeline.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
timeline.quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
timeline.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
timeline.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends his grotesque creations, including exploding winged turtles, to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.
timeline.quote: A wave of terrible creations swarmed over the walls of Havengul to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches skaabs at frantic speed in his hidden laboratory as Havengul falls, and his skaabs bring in a massive beast.
timeline.quote: a group of the skaabs he'd set to gathering raw materials entered, half-carrying and half-dragging a massive beast.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf's antlered behemoth steps over the city wall and tramples Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf asks Gisa to give up her broken sea-beast so his skaabs can retrieve both monsters, and Gisa, after a tantrum, agrees on condition he owes her.
timeline.quote: If your creations can drag it back to your lab, I'll let it go. But you'll owe me!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches the behemoth and sea-beast together in a city square, believing it will be his masterpiece.
timeline.quote: Grabbing the drill he would need to create seams through the beast's chitinous armor, he grinned to himself and set to work.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The siblings burn dead Phyrexians in a bonfire and bicker over who won the game; Geralf notes the fused beast has collapsed.
timeline.quote: "Neither of us won," Gisa snapped.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's laboratory in Havengul, and he forces her out; Ludevic and Sorin Markov warn him of the Phyrexian threat.
timeline.quote: They warned him about the impending Phyrexian threat.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The siblings collaborate to rout the Phyrexian invaders but resume feuding afterward.
timeline.quote: The siblings collaborated to rout the invaders but returned to feuding as soon as they were gone.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's lab in Havengul, is forced out, and takes over the Engelturm.
timeline.quote: She took over the Engelturm left behind by the angels.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The siblings join forces against the Phyrexian invasion of Innistrad and defeat New Phyrexia's forces, then return to their rivalry.
timeline.quote: the two siblings joined forces once again, defeating the forces of New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion strikes; Gisa and Geralf defeat a force at Havengul and Innistrad's zombies prove immune to phyresis.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf Cecani defeated a powerful Phyrexian invasion force attacking Havengul

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
timeline.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko sends Gisa and Geralf to retrieve the map from Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: "Are the two of you up for a little side mission?"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf return with the map, revealing the path to Tarnation and the vault.
timeline.quote: "I believe this is what you were after."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The siblings camp at night and Geralf observes that Gisa's zombies are not weakening, testing his planar theory.
timeline.quote: Her wellspring of Innistrad energy had yet to run dry.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf wakes Gisa, who fell asleep on watch, and they set off for Thief's Folly with her zombie animals following.
timeline.quote: They rode off into the dawn, Gisa's mismatched zombie army hopping, scurrying, and slithering after them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The siblings reach Thief's Folly and find it a patchwork of tombs from many planes.
timeline.quote: The architecture of the tombs and design of the grave markers were a patchwork amalgam of dozens of planes

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf realizes the grave sigils are an incantation just as Gisa's whistling triggers a trap, and a giant corpsipede erupts.
timeline.quote: what looked like a centipede made from hundreds of bodies fused together

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella Lee, visiting Lucy Bluff's grave, hears the siblings arguing and meets them.
timeline.quote: Stella stepped around a crypt, and found herself looking at two pale, dark-haired people in tattered clothing.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The corpsipede attacks and all three flee to the necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: "Run," said the man, grabbing the woman by the arm and charging straight toward Stella.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella gives Geralf a bottle of angel's blood and lamp oil for free, as she has friends buried in the graveyard.
timeline.quote: "Then it's on the house." Stella tossed him the bottle

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf uses the angel's blood to stitch a construct from Gisa's griffin to fight the corpsipede.
timeline.quote: Wild laughter rose in the distance, followed by Geralf walking back into view, leading a horrifying construct behind him.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.
